column1: # Table S3: Wild-type versus modification-deficient calls on the shared testable universe.

# note: The shared testable universe of a matched pair is the set of exonic positions with coverage >= 10 and a modification-compatible reference base in BOTH samples; the ratio is the deficient-condition call count over the wild-type call count on that universe (Fig. 2A). Mouse pairs are one per independent study and are never pooled. Deficient samples are fip37 KD (Arabidopsis), Mettl3 KO (mouse) and the unmodified IVT library (HeLa); KO/KD are partial negatives, so the ratio is a relative enrichment change, not a specificity measure. The per-pair values are deposited in the machine-readable table that accompanies the source code.
